name: weekly-threshold-xp
description: WAS with Goal Completion % >= 100% and Threshold XP Ready?=1 awards WEEKLY_THRESHOLD|{enrollment}|{week}|{percent} tiers via 035 v1.1.
prerequisites: Table Enrollments record recgP9qZYjAhE7NXm has Active?=true
Active XP Reward Rules Rule Key WEEKLY_THRESHOLD_100_{band}, WEEKLY_THRESHOLD_125_{band}, WEEKLY_THRESHOLD_150_{band} with XP Amount 10/20/30
Automation 035 v1.1 pasted, input recordId mapped, left OFF until first test
Mike UI-attest: no other Threshold XP automation ON
setup_steps: Select Schmidt WAS for the target Week (confirm Enrollment=recgP9qZYjAhE7NXm)
Confirm Goal Completion % >= 1; if lower, add counted Submissions until formula reaches >= 1
If Threshold XP Status = Processed, set Requeue Threshold XP = true
Run automation 035 Test with recordId = that WAS record id

input_fields.automation: 035 - Weekly Summary and Goal Logic - Create Weekly Threshold XP Events
input_fields.input_mapping: Triggering Weekly Athlete Summary record id

prohibited_side_effects: Writing formula Goal Completion % / Threshold XP Ready?
cleanup_instructions: Optional: delete created Weekly Threshold XP Events for this WAS; set Threshold XP Status blank; leave Requeue unchecked
manual_requirements: Seed WAS shots to cross 100% (and optionally 125/150)
current_automation_support: 035 v1.1 + WAS Threshold XP Ready? formula
